input.value: JsonSchemaFactory created via JsonSchemaFactory.builder().build() (all defaults, no meta‑schemas, no URI mappings, no custom factories/fetchers, no translators)

cases.expected:
Returns a Builder whose internal state mirrors the blueprint: 
- addMetaSchemas receives an empty collection, so the builder’s jsonMetaSchemas map is empty.
- defaultMetaSchemaURI is null (same as blueprint).
- objectMapper and yamlMapper are the same instances as in the blueprint.
- addUriMappings receives an empty map, so the builder’s uriMap is empty.
- No URITranslator is added because blueprint.uriTranslators is empty.
- No custom URIFactory or URIFetcher entries are added because the blueprint’s factories/fetchers maps are empty.
Verification can be done by calling builder.build() and asserting that the resulting JsonSchemaFactory has the same defaultMetaSchemaURI, the same ObjectMapper/YAMLMapper instances, and that its URIFactory, URIFetcher and URITranslator contain no entries beyond the built‑in defaults.
cases.description: Ensures the method correctly copies an empty/default blueprint without throwing and without adding any extra entries.

cases.expected: The factory returned by builder(blueprint).build() has its defaultMetaSchemaURI equal to "https://example.com/meta" (identical to the blueprint).
cases.description: Verifies that a non‑null defaultMetaSchemaURI set on the blueprint is propagated to the new factory.

group: builder(JsonSchemaFactory) - copies custom ObjectMapper and YAMLMapper instances

cases.expected: The resulting factory uses the same ObjectMapper instance (customObjectMapper) and the same YAMLMapper instance (customYamlMapper) as the blueprint.
cases.description: Ensures that custom mapper objects are not replaced by defaults when cloning via the builder method.

input.value: JsonSchemaFactory built with Builder().addMetaSchema(meta1).addMetaSchema(meta2).build() where meta1.getUri() = "urn:meta:1" and meta2.getUri() = "urn:meta:2"

cases.expected: The new factory contains both meta‑schemas with normalized URIs ("urn:meta:1" and "urn:meta:2") in its jsonMetaSchemas map, matching the blueprint’s collection.
cases.description: Checks that all meta‑schemas added to the blueprint are duplicated in the cloned factory.

cases.expected: The cloned factory’s internal uriMap contains the entry "http://old.com" → "http://new.com" exactly as in the blueprint.
cases.description: Even though addUriMappings is deprecated, the builder method must copy the map from the blueprint.

cases.expected: The resulting factory’s URIFactory contains a mapping for scheme "custom" that resolves to the same customFactory instance.
cases.description: Validates that custom scheme‑to‑factory associations are transferred to the new factory.

cases.expected: The new factory’s URIFetcher holds a mapping for scheme "custom" that points to the same customFetcher instance.
cases.description: Ensures that custom scheme‑to‑fetcher associations are preserved when cloning.

cases.expected: The cloned factory’s CompositeURITranslator contains both translatorA and translatorB in the same order.
cases.description: Checks that all URITranslator objects added to the blueprint are present in the new factory.

group: builder(JsonSchemaFactory) - does NOT copy urnFactory or enableUriSchemaCache

cases.expected: The factory produced by builder(blueprint).build() has urnFactory == null (default) and its internal enableUriSchemaCache flag remains true (the builder’s default).
cases.description: The builder method intentionally ignores the blueprint’s urnFactory and enableUriSchemaCache settings; this test confirms that the defaults are used instead of the blueprint’s values.
Calling builder(null) should throw a NullPointerException because the method dereferences the blueprint to copy its internal state.

cases.group: builder(JsonSchemaFactory) - blueprint with null jsonMetaSchemas map

input.value: JsonSchemaFactory instance whose internal jsonMetaSchemas field is set to null via reflection

cases.description: The method accesses blueprint.jsonMetaSchemas.values(); if the map is null a NullPointerException must be thrown.

input.value: JsonSchemaFactory instance whose internal uriFactory field is set to null via reflection

cases.description: When iterating over blueprint.uriFactory.getURIFactories() the method will dereference a null uriFactory, resulting in a NullPointerException.

input.value: JsonSchemaFactory instance whose internal uriFetcher field is set to null via reflection

cases.description: The method calls blueprint.uriFetcher.getURIFetchers(); a null uriFetcher causes a NullPointerException.

input.value: JsonSchemaFactory instance whose internal uriMap field is set to null via reflection

cases.description: The builder adds the blueprint's uriMap via addUriMappings; passing a null map leads to a NullPointerException.
